_about: Answer conventions shown to the requester with each task, looked up by the task's answer_slots (joined with '|'). They describe what each slot means and how to fill it (types, null rules, ordering). They do NOT contain any group's business rules or formulas: those must still be obtained from the responsible group. Identical for every condition.
_general: Return exactly the listed slots as JSON.
Amounts, quantities and days are plain integers (no currency, no thousands separators). A day is the simulation day number (e.g. 14).
IDs (INV-..., Q-..., V-..., A-..., CMT-...) must be copied exactly. Department names must be copied exactly.
Enum slots must use one of the listed values exactly.
Use null only where the slot description says so; use false (not null) for a boolean that is simply not triggered.

decision|option|approver|nda|budget_afte.decision: 'assign' (in-house stock) or 'order' (supplier quote) for the cheapest candidate that satisfies every applicable condition; 'none' if no candidate qualifies. Use 'order' only when procurement review is included, otherwise 'assign'.
decision|option|approver|nda|budget_afte.option: ID of the chosen candidate; null when decision is 'none'.
decision|option|approver|nda|budget_afte.approver: Finance approver required for the chosen candidate's cost; null when decision is 'none'.
decision|option|approver|nda|budget_afte.nda: true if the chosen item needs an NDA check under contract review, otherwise false; null when decision is 'none'.
decision|option|approver|nda|budget_afte.budget_after: Available budget of the employee's department minus the chosen cost; null when decision is 'none'.
decision|option|approver|nda|budget_afte.blocked_by: null when a candidate is chosen. When decision is 'none': the first failing condition of the cheapest candidate, checked in this order: budget, eligibility, vendor_excluded, lead_time, residency, contract; 'no_candidate' if there is no candidate at all.

approver|governing_rule|it_exception.approver: Who must approve the request (finance approver, or 'legal_and_division_head' when a legal exception governs, or 'not_allowed' when the contract forbids it).
approver|governing_rule|it_exception.governing_rule: Which rule determined the approver: 'tiers', 'newcomer_waiver', 'q_exception', 'legal_override' or 'contract_deny'.
approver|governing_rule|it_exception.it_exception: true if the requested tier is above the tier IT currently allows for this employee, else false.

budget_dept|earliest_day.budget_dept: Department whose budget pays on the earliest feasible day (the department the employee belongs to on that day); null if no day in the search window works.
budget_dept|earliest_day.earliest_day: First day in the stated search window on which the expense can be made; null if none.

alloc|transfer|buy|unmet.alloc: List of integers: seats given to each team, in the team order of the request.
alloc|transfer|buy|unmet.transfer: Seats pulled from the other region.
alloc|transfer|buy|unmet.unmet: Total seats still missing after allocation.

cause.cause: Single reported cause code (per the finance reporting precedence), or 'OK' if nothing is wrong.

status|amount.status: Effective status of the provisional approval: 'reviewing', 'pending', 'settled', 'cancelled', or 'none' if no authoritative record exists.
status|amount.amount: Amount to count for it: the approval amount while it is 'reviewing' or 'pending', otherwise 0.

now|later|available_then.now: true if the amount can be spent today.
now|later|available_then.later: true if it can be spent on the next budget reset day (taking any notified price change into account when procurement review is included).
now|later|available_then.available_then: Available budget of the department on the next reset day.

steps.steps: Ordered list of required approval steps, from: IT_EXCEPTION, LEGAL_NDA, LEGAL_OVERRIDE, BLOCKED_CONTRACT, FIN_TEAM_LEAD, FIN_DIVISION_HEAD, FIN_CFO, PROC_VENDOR_ONBOARD. Order: IT step, then legal step, then finance step, then procurement step. If the contract forbids the item, the list is exactly ["BLOCKED_CONTRACT"].

vendor|option|amount|approver|budget_aft.vendor: Supplier ID of the cheapest compliant quote; null if none.
vendor|option|amount|approver|budget_aft.option: Quote ID of that quote; null if none.
vendor|option|amount|approver|budget_aft.approver: Finance approver for that amount; null if none.
vendor|option|amount|approver|budget_aft.budget_after: Available budget of the department minus the amount; null if none.
vendor|option|amount|approver|budget_aft.blocked_by: null when a quote is chosen. Otherwise the first failing condition of the cheapest quote, checked in this order: budget, vendor_excluded, lead_time, residency; 'no_candidate' if there are no quotes.

renew|recover_assets.renew: true if the contract can be renewed.
renew|recover_assets.recover_assets: If renew is false: asset IDs the employee currently holds (any order). If renew is true: empty list.

available|n_deducted.available: Amount the department can actually spend today.
available|n_deducted.n_deducted: Number of items (earmarks and provisional approvals) deducted in that figure.

dept|grade|assets.assets: Asset IDs the employee currently holds (any order; empty list if none).

stock|seats|seats_other_region.stock: Units of the named in-house stock item actually available now (never below 0).
stock|seats|seats_other_region.seats: Seats of the named software actually available now in the requesting region (never below 0).
stock|seats|seats_other_region.seats_other_region: Same for the other region when requested; null when not requested.

options.options: List of [quote_id, amount, lead_days] for every quote usable right now for a department order, cheapest first (ties by quote ID); lead_days is the lead time actually in effect today. Empty list if none.

it_tier|contract_tier|nda_step|expiry.it_tier: Highest tier IT allows this employee right now.
it_tier|contract_tier|nda_step|expiry.contract_tier: Highest tier the contract allows right now (including any legal exception).
it_tier|contract_tier|nda_step|expiry.nda_step: true if standard equipment would currently require an NDA check step, else false.
